### quotes-semicolon | kinds=read,read | flags=
echo "a;b|c" && ls

### grep-ere | kinds=read | flags=
grep -E 'a|b' /etc/hosts

### quotes-section-semicolon | kinds=read | flags=
echo '=== A;B ==='

### docker-sh-quotes | kinds=read,read | flags= | inner=docker:web01
docker exec web01 sh -c 'echo a && echo b'

### printf-arrow | kinds=read | flags=
printf '%s\n' "x > y"
